AUDIT STANDING COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  TEMPLE CITY, CALIFORNIA

  SEPTEMBER 18, 12:00 P.M.
  CITY HALL CONFERENCE ROOM– 9701 LAS TUNAS DRIVE

YOU HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO ADDRESS THE STANDING COMMITTEE AT THE
FOLLOWING TIMES:

•  AGENDA ITEM: at the time the standing committee considers the agenda item;

•  NON-AGENDA ITEM: at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while the
  standing committee values your comments, pursuant to the Brown Act, the standing committee
  cannot take action on any item not listed on the agenda.

WRITTEN COMMENT

Written public comments received on the day of the meeting will be provided to the standing
committee and made part of the meeting record. Written public comments will not be read aloud
by city staff or the standing committee.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to
participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk at (626) 285-2171. Notification 48
hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure
accessibility to this meeting.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to
participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk at (626) 285-2171. Notification 48
hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure
accessibility to this meeting.

  1.  CALL TO ORDER

  2.  ROLL CALL – Councilmember Yu, Councilmember Chavez

  3.  PUBLIC COMMENTS

  4.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  All Consent Calendar items may be approved in a single motion as recommended
  unless removed for further discussion. If members of the Standing Committee or
  persons in the audience wish to discuss any matters listed on the Consent
  Calendar, please address them at this time.

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The Standing Committee is requested to review and approve Minutes of the
  Special Standing Committee Meeting of March 30, 2026

  Recommendation:  Approve.

  Attachment:  Meeting Minutes of March 30, 2026

5.  NEW BUSINESS

  A. AUDIT COMMUNICATIONS FOR START OF FISCAL YEAR (FY) 2025-2026
  FINANCIAL AUDIT

  The Standing Committee is requested to communicate with the auditor
  regarding the start of the FY 2025-2026 financial audit.

  Presentation:  Kassie  Radermacher,  Principal  Auditor
  CLA LLP

  Recommendation:  Receive Report

6.  OTHER UPDATES FROM THE ADIMINISTRATIVE SERVICES DIRECTOR

7.  SCHEDULE NEXT MEETING DATE

8.  ADJOURNMENT
